metadata.note: All models have pricing.prompt = 0 (confirmed truly free). Rate limits apply: ~20 req/min, ~200 req/day per model.

free_models.name: NVIDIA: Nemotron 3 Ultra 550B A55B
free_models.notes: Largest free model available. 550B params. Best for complex reasoning and multi-step tasks.

free_models.name: NVIDIA: Nemotron 3 Super 120B A12B
free_models.notes: 120B params. 1M context. Excellent at structured JSON output. NVIDIA-backed, reliable.

free_models.name: Qwen: Qwen3 Coder 480B A35B
free_models.notes: 480B params. Coding-optimized. Largest context window of all free models (1,048,576). Strong JSON.

free_models.name: Qwen: Qwen3 Next 80B A3B Instruct
free_models.notes: 80B params. MoE architecture. 262K context. Good general instruction following.

free_models.name: Google: Gemma 4 31B Instruct
free_models.notes: 31B params. 262K context. Supports tool calling. Google-backed, very reliable.

free_models.name: Google: Gemma 4 26B A4B
free_models.notes: 26B MoE params. 262K context. Efficient variant of Gemma 4.

free_models.name: OpenAI: GPT-OSS 120B
free_models.notes: OpenAI's open-source 120B model. Excellent instruction following and JSON output quality.

free_models.name: OpenAI: GPT-OSS 20B
free_models.notes: Lighter 20B version. Faster inference than 120B. Good for high-frequency tasks.

free_models.name: Nous: Hermes 3 405B Instruct
free_models.notes: 405B params. Hermes fine-tuned on Llama 3.1. Strong at complex multi-step instructions.

free_models.name: Meta: Llama 3.3 70B Instruct
free_models.notes: 70B params. 131K context. Extremely battle-tested and reliable for structured JSON tasks. Currently in project backup chain.

free_models.name: Nex AGI: Nex-N2-Pro
free_models.notes: 262K context. General purpose model from Nex AGI.

free_models.name: Poolside: Laguna M.1
free_models.notes: 262K context. Flagship coding and agentic model from Poolside.

free_models.name: Poolside: Laguna XS.2
free_models.notes: Lighter variant of Laguna. 262K context. Good for fast agentic tasks.

free_models.name: NVIDIA: Nemotron 3 Nano 30B A3B
free_models.notes: 30B MoE (3B active). 256K context. Fast inference with large context.

free_models.name: NVIDIA: Nemotron 3 Nano Omni 30B Reasoning
free_models.notes: Omni variant with reasoning. 256K context. Good for tasks needing chain-of-thought.

free_models.name: NVIDIA: Nemotron Nano 12B V2 VL
free_models.notes: 12B vision-language model. Suitable for image understanding tasks.

free_models.name: NVIDIA: Nemotron Nano 9B V2
free_models.notes: Small 9B model. 32K context only. Use for simple, short-text tasks.

free_models.name: NVIDIA: Nemotron 3.5 Content Safety
free_models.notes: Specialized for content safety classification only. Not a general-purpose model.

free_models.name: OpenRouter: Owl Alpha
free_models.notes: OpenRouter's own model. 1M context. Alpha stage, may be experimental.

free_models.name: Meta: Llama 3.2 3B Instruct
free_models.notes: 3B params only. Ultra-fast but limited quality for complex tasks. Use for simple extraction.

free_models.name: Mistral: Magistral Medium 2509
free_models.notes: Context window unspecified in API (may vary). Reasoning-focused. Verify before production use.

free_models.name: LiquidAI: LFM2.5-1.2B-Thinking
free_models.notes: 1.2B params. Tiny thinking model. 32K context. Use only for very simple tasks.

free_models.name: LiquidAI: LFM2.5-1.2B-Instruct
free_models.notes: 1.2B params. Tiny instruct model. 32K context. Extremely fast but limited capability.

free_models.name: Venice: Uncensored Dolphin Mistral 24B
free_models.notes: 24B uncensored model. 32K context. Avoid for production news bots due to uncensored nature.

free_models.name: Google: Lyria 3 Pro Preview
free_models.notes: AUDIO GENERATION MODEL ONLY. Not a text LLM. Do not use for text processing tasks.

free_models.name: Google: Lyria 3 Clip Preview
free_models.notes: AUDIO GENERATION MODEL ONLY. Not a text LLM. Do not use for text processing tasks.

project_recommendations.use_case: Structured JSON extraction from tech news articles (headline, brief, breakdown, edge, deep_dive)

suggested_model_chain.reason: Large, NVIDIA-backed, 1M context, excellent structured output
OpenAI-quality JSON generation, 131K context, very reliable
Battle-tested, already in current backup chain, highly stable
Meta-router — dynamically picks any available free model
